Genuine transparent background; generous margins; no ground patch, shadow puddle, text, roof, border or scenery. Same front three-quarter camera about20degrees down; light upper-left, darker right/lower shade. Fine broken sepia-charcoal ink, main/detail2:1; quiet broad earth wash, no dense texture or3D bevel. Stone3 selective crack/facet groups per dominant rock; wood3 broken longitudinal grain lines per principal beam; clay3 short crack groups; hatching one group of3 parallel / marks. Physical footprint unchanged. Same east-west rectangular bridge footprint192x128px plan. Two long horizontal broken stringers and four low surviving corner stumps, five snapped deck planks fallen within the rectangle. Most deck absent, no upright intact rails; orthogonal plan not diamond. Intended game opaque height140px, footprint[3, 2]; preserve material and component identity at1x. CRITICAL: exactly rectangular orthogonal3x2 plan, both outer side edges strictly VERTICAL screenY and stringers strictly HORIZONTAL screenX. Broken short deckplanks can tilt inside, outer rectangle MUST NOT skew. Broad quiet tan wash and distinct darker right/lower shaded faces, no mottled allover wash.
